reminders.subject: It’s Time To Change Your Life…
reminders.sms: Hey Jordan, it’s time to take back control of your life. I'm excited to show you exactly how to do that on Thursday at 14:00.

reminders.subject: Here’s Everything Upfront.
reminders.sms: Hi Jordan, I sent you something via email. I think you’ll like it.

reminders.subject: Today's the Day…
reminders.sms: Hey Jordan, today is the day. You're going to look back on this day five years from now…

reminders.subject: Clock is ticking… Time is winding down.
reminders.sms: Jordan, our meeting is in 5 hours. I'm ready to go.

reminders.subject: It’s time…
reminders.sms: Hey Jordan, it’s time. Our meeting is in 10 minutes!

rescue.subject: You missed your call Jordan...
rescue.sms: Hey Jordan, you missed your call. You won't want to miss out on what I'm offering.

rescue.subject: Only You Are Stopping Yourself From Changing.
rescue.sms: There’s only one thing holding you back, Jordan. It's yourself.

rescue.subject: What are you waiting for?!?!
rescue.sms: Hey Jordan, what are you waiting for? Nothing is going to change if you don’t try something different.

rescue.subject: When will you get tired of being weak?
rescue.sms: Jordan, stop wasting your potential. Stop going through life as if you're already dead.

rescue.subject: Your Window Is Closing…
rescue.sms: Jordan, don't let this opportunity pass you by. It won't be around much longer.

rescue.subject: This is your last chance…
rescue.sms: Hey Jordan, this is my last time reaching out. Others have already taken that first step and are changing their lives.
